test_SegmentationMask_convert: test the SegmentationMask convert method to round-trip between poly and mask formats
test_SegmentationMask_crop: test the SegmentationMask crop method to crop masks by a bounding box
test_SegmentationMask_resize: test the SegmentationMask resize method to resize masks to a new width and height
test_SegmentationMask_transpose: test the SegmentationMask transpose method to flip masks horizontally or vertically
run_test_segmentation_mask: run the unittest test suite for SegmentationMask conversion, crop, resize, and transpose
